mapper.select:
SELECT s.id as skuId, p.name as productName, s.sku_code as skuCode, p.image_url as imageUrl, s.import_price as currentImportPrice, s.selling_price as sellingPrice FROM product p JOIN sku s ON p.id = s.product_id
p.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.is_active = TRUE
AND ( LOWER(p.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(s.sku_code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )
ORDER BY p.name ASC LIMIT 20
